en.name: English
en.title: Rize Teknoloji: Wavvy apps for Android TV, phone and tablet
en.description: Rize Teknoloji publishes the Wavvy apps for Android TV, phone and tablet: Wavvy TV Plus, Wavvy IP Camera, Wavvy Player, Wavvy Vault, Wavvy Beam, Wavvy Words and Wavvy Surf.
en.og_description: The Wavvy apps for Android TV, phone and tablet.
en.h1: For the <mark>big screen</mark>. And the one in your pocket.
en.lead: Apps for Android TV, phones and tablets: IPTV, IP cameras, video, casting, passwords, English word puzzles and an ad-free web browser.
en.apps_note: Each app has its own website.
en.tv: Load your own M3U, Xtream Codes or Stalker playlist and watch live TV, movies and series with a TV guide, Multi-View and Cloud Sync.
en.cam: Watch your RTSP and ONVIF IP cameras on the TV, phone or tablet, several at once in a multi-camera grid.
en.player: Play MKV, MP4 and 4K HDR from your device, USB, SMB/NAS, WebDAV, FTP and DLNA, with subtitles and DTS and Dolby audio.
en.vault: An offline password manager: passwords, PINs and cards in an encrypted vault on your phone, with fingerprint unlock and autofill. No account, no cloud.
en.beam: Cast videos, music and photos from your phone to Chromecast, Google TV and DLNA smart TVs, and use your phone as an Android TV remote.
en.words: An arrow-word crossword for people learning English: clues in your own language, answers in English. Levels A1 to C1, a word notebook, offline play.
en.about_text: Rize Teknoloji is the publisher name of an independent app developer based in Türkiye. It is not a registered company. Apps with a TV version are built to work the same on a TV remote and a touch screen.
en.trademark: Google Play is a trademark of Google LLC.
en.surf: A fast web browser for Android TV and Google TV that blocks ads and trackers. Your remote works as a mouse, videos play full screen, and you can type on your phone.
